sections.title: GURPS 4e enhancements (the +% affixes an ability can carry)
sections.coverage: ok — lines 15358..16523 of GURPS 4e - Basic Set - Characters.md

entries.name: Accurate
entries.gloss: Your attack is unusually accurate. Each +1 to Accuracy is a +5% enhancement.

entries.name: Affects Insubstantial
entries.gloss: Your ability affects insubstantial targets in addition to normal, substantial things.

entries.name: Affects Substantial
entries.gloss: Your ability affects substantial tar- gets even when you are insubstantial.

entries.name: Area Effect
entries.gloss: Your ability works as an area power instead of affecting a single target.

entries.name: Armor Divisor
entries.gloss: Your attack can pierce more armor than its base damage would indicate.

entries.name: Aura
entries.gloss: Your attack takes the form of a malefic aura that affects anyone you touch (reach C) or who touches you.

entries.name: Blood Agent
entries.gloss: On an attack with Area Effect or Cone, this is an enhancement.

entries.name: Cone
entries.gloss: Your attack spreads to affect every- one in a cone-shaped area.

entries.name: Contact Agent
entries.gloss: On an attack with Area Effect or Cone, this is an enhancement.

entries.name: Cosmic
entries.gloss: Your ability operates on a “higher level” than is usual in your game world.

entries.name: Cyclic
entries.gloss: This enhancement is only available for Innate Attacks that inflict burning, corrosion, fatigue, or toxic damage.

entries.name: Damage Modifiers
entries.gloss: You may give an Innate Attack one or more of these modifiers to further qualify the way it does damage.

entries.name: Hazard
entries.gloss: You may give an Innate Attack that inflicts fatigue damage one of these enhancements: Dehydration, +20%; Drowning, +0%; Freezing, +20%; Missed Sleep, +50%; Starvation, +40%; or Suffocation, +0%.

entries.name: Delay
entries.gloss: This enhancement delays the attack’s effects until sometime after you hit the target.

entries.name: Drifting
entries.gloss: You may add this enhancement to any attack with Delay (above) or Persistent (p.

entries.name: Extended Duration
entries.gloss: This enhancement increases the normal duration of your ability.

entries.name: Follow-Up
entries.gloss: Your attack’s effects are delivered by a “carrier.” Use this to represent poison on a dart, an explosive in an armor-piercing shell, etc.

entries.name: Guided or Homing
entries.gloss: You can guide your attack – or per- haps it “homes in” by itself!

entries.name: Increased Range
entries.gloss: You may add this enhancement to any advantage that has a range; e.g., Innate Attack or Scanning Sense.

entries.name: Jet
entries.gloss: Your attack is a continuous stream, like a flamethrower.

entries.name: Malediction
entries.gloss: Your attack is not a conventional ranged attack; it works more like a Regular spell (p.

entries.name: Mobile
entries.gloss: You may only add this enhance- ment to an attack that has both Area Effect (p.

entries.name: Overhead
entries.gloss: Your attack can alter its angle to strike from a different side of the tar- get – usually the top.

entries.name: Persistent
entries.gloss: You may only add this enhance- ment to an Area Effect (p.

entries.name: Ranged
entries.gloss: This enhancement gives range to an advantage that normally affects your immediate area, or that requires a touch to affect others.

entries.name: Rapid Fire
entries.gloss: An Innate Attack’s base Rate of Fire (RoF) is 1.

entries.name: Reduced Fatigue Cost
entries.gloss: You may only take this enhance- ment for abilities that cost FP, and never in conjunction with the special modifier “Usually On.” You can take it any number of times.

entries.name: Reduced Time
entries.gloss: You may only add this enhance- ment to abilities that require time to activate.

entries.name: Respiratory Agent
entries.gloss: Your attack must be inhaled to have any effect, but it ignores all DR.

entries.name: Selective Area
entries.gloss: You may add this enhancement to any Area Effect (p.

entries.name: Selectivity
entries.gloss: This enhancement lets you turn a trait’s other enhancements off and on at will.

entries.name: Sense-Based
entries.gloss: Your attack is channeled through your victim’s senses, allowing it to ignore DR!

entries.name: Side Effect
entries.gloss: You may only add this enhance- ment to an Innate Attack, and you cannot combine it with penetration modifiers other than Armor Divisor.

entries.name: Symptoms
entries.gloss: Symptoms are effects that occur if the cumulative damage (HP or FP loss) inflicted by the enhanced Innate Attack exceeds a fraction of the vic- tim’s basic HP or FP.

entries.name: Underwater
entries.gloss: Attacks are assumed to be usable in air or in vacuum, but ineffective in liq- uid.

entries.name: Variable
entries.gloss: You can reduce the level of your attack. For example, if you have an Innate Attack that normally does 3d damage, you could reduce it to 1d or 2d damage. You must indicate this before you make your attack roll. Wall 6 +30% or +60% You may only add this enhance-

sections.title: GURPS 4e limitations (the -% affixes an ability can carry)
sections.coverage: ok — lines 16524..17844 of GURPS 4e - Basic Set - Characters.md

entries.name: Accessibility
entries.gloss: Accessibility is a catchall limitation you can use to cover any restriction not specifically defined elsewhere.

entries.name: Always On
entries.gloss: You cannot switch your advantage off. You may only add this to an abili- ty that can normally be switched off and that is inconvenient if you can’t turn it off. It is worth -10% if the effects are social or cosmetic, -20% if they are physically inconvenient, a

entries.name: Armor Divisor
entries.gloss: Your attack can pierce less armor than its base damage would indicate.

entries.name: Blood Agent
entries.gloss: Your attack must reach a mucous membrane (eyes, open mouth, nose, etc.) or an open wound to have any effect at all.

entries.name: Bombardment
entries.gloss: You may only take this limitation in conjunction with Area Effect (p.

entries.name: Contact Agent
entries.gloss: Your attack must touch bare skin or porous clothing to have any effect at all.

entries.name: Costs Fatigue
entries.gloss: Your ability costs FP to use. This is worth -5% per FP per use. What con- stitutes a “use” depends on the under- lying trait. For abilities that produce instanta- neous effects (e.g., Innate Attack), you must pay this FP cost every time you trigger the ability

entries.name: Damage Limitations
entries.gloss: You may add the following limitations to an Innate Attack: No Blunt Trauma (nbt) -20% An attack that inflicts crushing, cutting, impaling, or piercing damage normally inflicts blunt trauma (see p.

entries.name: Dissipation
entries.gloss: You may only take this limitation in conjunction with Area Effect (p.

entries.name: Emanation
entries.gloss: You may only take this limitation in conjunction with Area Effect (p.

entries.name: Emergencies Only
entries.gloss: Your ability is triggered by your fear or excitement; you cannot use it under “routine” conditions.

entries.name: Inaccurate
entries.gloss: Your attack benefits little from careful aiming.

entries.name: Limited Use
entries.gloss: You can use your ability only a lim- ited number of times in a 24-hour peri- od.

entries.name: Melee Attack
entries.gloss: Your attack functions as a melee weapon. It has no range, but allows you to parry, use Rapid Strike, Feint, etc. It lacks Malf., 1/2D, Max, Acc, RoF, Shots, and Recoil statistics, and may not have any enhancement or limitation that modifies these statis- tics.

entries.name: Mitigator
entries.gloss: You may only apply this limitation to a disadvantage.

entries.name: Nuisance Effect
entries.gloss: Your ability has a “side effect” that causes you serious inconvenience.

entries.name: Onset
entries.gloss: You must “stack” this limitation with one of Blood Agent, Contact Agent, Follow-Up, Malediction, or Respiratory Agent.

entries.name: Pact
entries.gloss: A Higher Power – god, spirit, etc. – grants your ability under the condi- tion that you follow a strict moral code. This code must take the form of one or more of the traits listed under Self-Imposed Mental Disadvantages (p. 121). These disadvantages give you

entries.name: Preparation Required
entries.gloss: Your ability requires special prepa- ration before you can use it.

entries.name: Reduced Range
entries.gloss: You may add this limitation to any advantage that has a range; e.g., Innate Attack or Scanning Sense.

entries.name: Resistible
entries.gloss: This limitation is only available for Innate Attacks that inflict fatigue or toxic damage.

entries.name: Sense-Based
entries.gloss: On an attack with Malediction or an ability that normally ignores DR (e.g., Mind Control), this is a limita- tion.

entries.name: Takes Extra Time
entries.gloss: You can only apply this limitation to abilities that require time to acti- vate and that work fast enough to be useful in an emergency (e.g., combat).

entries.name: Takes Recharge
entries.gloss: Your ability requires “recharging” after each use.

entries.name: Disadvantage
entries.gloss: You may add this limitation to any advantage that can be switched off and on at will, and that takes at least one second to switch.

entries.name: Trigger
entries.gloss: Your advantage requires exposure to a specific substance or condition (e.g., a dose of a drug) to function.

entries.name: Unconscious Only
entries.gloss: You may only take this limitation in conjunction with Uncontrollable (below).

entries.name: Unreliable
entries.gloss: Sometimes your ability works and sometimes it doesn’t!

entries.name: Untrainable
entries.gloss: You may only apply this limitation to abilities that normally require a skill to use.

entries.name: Breakable
entries.gloss: Your foes can destroy the item. Once destroyed, it will cease to grant you its benefits until repaired. Add the following elements together to find the final limitation value. Durability: The easier the object is to break, the greater the limitation. Decide on

entries.name: Can Be Stolen
entries.gloss: Your foes can take this item from you, depriving you of its benefits.

entries.name: Unique
entries.gloss: You may only take this limitation in conjunction with Breakable or Can Be Stolen.

sections.title: GURPS 4e Powers enhancements (the new +% affixes from Powers)

entries.name: Affects Others
entries.gloss: You can extend your advantage’s benefits to others.

entries.name: Can Carry Objects
entries.gloss: A physical transformation normal- ly affects your body but not your belongings.

entries.name: Erosive
entries.gloss: Erosive must accompany one of Blood Agent, Contact Agent, or Respiratory Agent, and either Area Effect or Cone.

entries.name: Force Field
entries.gloss: This enhancement converts a defensive trait into a field projected a short distance from your body.

entries.name: Game Time
entries.gloss: Some traits – including Luck, Serendipity, and Wild Talent – rely on real time.

entries.name: Long-Range
entries.gloss: Your ranged ability uses a better class of range penalties than usual.

entries.name: Once On, Stays On
entries.gloss: Only for physical transformations that end if you’re knocked out or killed – mainly Elastic Skin, Shadow Form, and Shapeshifting.

entries.name: Reflexive
entries.gloss: Reflexive is for defenses that take a second to activate, senses that require a second of concentration (e.g., Detect), and anything the GM feels serves a purpose similar to either.

entries.name: Ricochet
entries.gloss: When using Ricochets (p. 166), your attack doesn’t lose damage on each bounce. Selective Effect see Selective Area, p. 105 Surprise Attack see Overhead, p. 104

entries.name: Switchable
entries.gloss: This enhancement only exists for physiological features (e.g., Claws), defenses, and other traits that are nor- mally “always on.” It lets you switch your advantage off and on with a Ready maneuver.

entries.name: Time-Spanning
entries.gloss: Your ability works across time. Rolls to use it this way have a penalty for the time gap between you and your target; use Long-Distance Modifiers (p. B241) and substitute “days” for “miles.” Find the distance in space as if you were at the same point in time.

sections.title: GURPS 4e Powers limitations (the new -% affixes from Powers)

entries.name: All-Out
entries.gloss: Your ability requires an All-Out Attack maneuver; you can’t use it with any other maneuver (e.g., Move or Change Posture).

entries.name: Aspected
entries.gloss: Your ability works only when pur- suing a specific class of related tasks or activities (e.g., athletics, combat, investigation, or social interaction), or in a specific area of daily life (e.g., job, personal health, or romance).

entries.name: Costs Hit Points
entries.gloss: This limitation works exactly like Costs Fatigue (p.

entries.name: Environmental
entries.gloss: Only advantages that affect others can have this limitation.

entries.name: Fickle
entries.gloss: Your ability is or seems sentient, and sometimes reacts poorly.

entries.name: Glamour
entries.gloss: Only available for Chameleon, Elastic Skin, Invisibility, Shape- shifting (with the Cosmetic limita- tion), Silence, and similar traits that alter how others perceive you.

entries.name: Insubstantial Only
entries.gloss: Your ability only affects intangible targets: beings with the Spirit meta- trait, individuals using Insubstan- tiality, and those using Clairsentience, Jumper, or Warp with the Projection special modifier.

entries.name: Maximum Duration
entries.gloss: Only available for switchable, beneficial abilities that you could normally leave “on” indefinitely (e.g., Insubstantiality).

entries.name: Minimum Duration
entries.gloss: Only available for switchable abil- ities that would – in the GM’s opinion – seriously inconvenience you if you couldn’t deactivate them at will.

entries.name: Greater than one month
entries.gloss: On an advantage that allows Always On, this limitation is worth at most -5% less than Always On; e.g., if Always On is -20%, Minimum Duration can’t go beyond -15%.

entries.name: Short-Range
entries.gloss: Your ranged ability is subject to more severe range penalties than usual.

entries.name: Specific
entries.gloss: Specific restricts an ability that lets you interact with a material to a sub- set of what it normally affects.

entries.name: Terminal Condition
entries.gloss: Only allowed on abilities that affect others for at least a minute.
